claims.claim: Consolidated Alphabet revenues for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 were $119.8 billion.
Consolidated revenues increased 24% year over year in Q2 2026.
Consolidated revenues increased 23% on a non-GAAP constant currency basis in Q2 2026.
Net income available to common stockholders increased 298% to $112.1 billion for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Diluted net income per common share increased 294% to $9.11 for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Consolidated operating income increased 30% to $40.8 billion in Q2 2026.
Operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34% in Q2 2026.
Other income, net, reflected a net gain of $98.0 billion for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, primarily due to net unrealized gains on equity securities.
Google Services revenues increased 15% to $94.5 billion.
Google Search & other revenues grew 17%.
Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices revenues grew 15%.
YouTube ads revenues grew 13%.
Google Cloud revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion.
Google Cloud growth was led by increases in Google Cloud Platform across enterprise AI Solutions, enterprise AI Infrastructure, and core GCP services.
Other Bets revenues were $382 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Other Bets recorded an operating loss of $1.8 billion in Q2 2026.
The release provides no guidance or outlook.
In June 2026, the company issued a combination of Class A stock, Class C stock, and mandatory convertible preferred stock for aggregate net proceeds of $49.6 billion.
The June 2026 equity raise proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including AI infrastructure and global compute.
The company entered into an equity distribution agreement to sell up to $40.0 billion of Class A and Class C stock through an At-the-Market Program.
ATM Program proceeds are primarily intended to meet tax obligations associated with employee equity grants.
In the second quarter of 2026, the company issued senior unsecured notes for net proceeds of $20.3 billion for general corporate purposes.
The net gain on equity securities was $99.0 billion.
The release notes the equity securities gain increased net income by $77.1 billion and diluted net income per common share by $6.26.
The release states fluctuations in the value of investments may significantly contribute to volatility in future periods.
As of June 30, 2026, the company had not sold any shares under the At-the-Market Program.
